assets.prompt: Create a polished art-director concept illustration for a Taiwanese indie management game titled internally Law Firm Simulator. It must be true 2D PIXEL ART with sharply aligned pixel clusters, a restrained 32-color palette, no smooth digital painting, no 3D render, no isometric perspective. Landscape 16:9. Show a charming but weary small Taipei lawyer office as a straight-on cutaway room in slight top-down RPG perspective: warm amber desk lamps, muted teal cabinets, dusty paper stacks, beige files, old green desk chairs, compact photocopier, three small desks, one consultation table, two human characters at 32x48 sprite scale, a weary young lawyer with pale shirt and rolled-up sleeves and a navy-suited coworker, crisp readable silhouettes. Tall windows show Taipei dense midrise city blocks at blue dusk with a distant recognizable Taipei 101 silhouette. Subtle story: files and inbox overflow, budget-ledger notebook and coffee. Cozy but stressful, dry workplace humor, financial and energy management mood. Large office environment dominates, uncluttered margins, very deliberate tile-based composition, production concept art quality for an indie game pitch deck. NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO fake Chinese glyphs, NO UI overlay, NO logos, no legal-courtroom fighting, no scales of justice giant symbol. The work is an original game environment concept reference, not a screenshot of an existing game.
